CustomField.formula: TEXT(Production_Approved_Count__c) & " of " & TEXT(Production_Approved_Count__c + Production_Pending_Count__c + Production_Rejected_Count__c) & " Approved · " & TEXT(Production_Pending_Count__c) & " Pending · " & TEXT(Production_Rejected_Count__c) & " Rejected"
